_about: Day 7 questions written 2026-11-16 by reading the Day 6 normalized page text (pages.jsonl), on pages that no Day 6 question uses. Test questions were written before any Day 7 run and are not used for tuning. Unanswerable questions were checked by searching all 81 content pages for the key terms (see absence_reason). `filter` is assumed user context (which edition is open), never derived from gold. questions.question: By how much did the monthly average wage grow in 2018, in nominal and in real terms?
questions.expected_answer: About 7.4 percent in nominal terms, or about 3.9 percent in real terms.

gold.evidence: the monthly average wage is estimated to have expanded by 7.4 percent in nominal terms or by about 3.9 percent in real terms in 2018

questions.question: How much of each dollar spent by visitors leaks out of Vietnam's economy through imports, and how does this compare with the regional average?
questions.expected_answer: Around 0.27 cents per dollar in Vietnam, versus an average of 0.47 cents for Southeast Asia (a relatively low leakage).

gold.evidence: this tourism leakage factor has been relatively low-around 0.27 cents per dollar compared to an average of 0.47 cents for the Southeast Asia region

questions.question: What share of workers in the tourism sector are trained specifically in tourism, and what about the rest?
questions.expected_answer: Only 42 percent are trained in tourism; 38 percent came from other sectors and 20 percent have no official training.

gold.evidence: only 42 percent of workers in the sector are trained specifically in tourism, whereas 38 percent have come from other sectors, and 20 percent have no official training

questions.question: According to the household survey, what share of family businesses had closed temporarily or permanently by June 2020?

gold.evidence: Only 4.3% of family businesses had closed temporarily or permanently

questions.question: What would happen to public investment if the government raised the execution rate of the approved 2020 investment budget from 65 to 75 percent?
questions.expected_answer: Public investment would rise by 1.5 percentage points of GDP, directly injecting around US$4 billion into the local economy.

gold.evidence: the ratio of public investment over GDP would rise by 1.5 percentage points of GDP, directly injecting around US$4 billion into the local economy

questions.question: What real GDP growth does the World Bank baseline forecast project for Vietnam for 2019 and for 2021?
questions.expected_answer: 6.6 percent in 2019 and 6.5 percent in 2021 (also 6.5 percent in 2020).

gold.evidence: projects real GDP growth in Vietnam at 6.6 percent in 2019 and 6.5 percent in both 2020 and 2021
with a slight deceleration to 6.5 percent in 2020 and 2021

questions.gold_note: Second gold (p10) supports only the 2020/2021 part; grade answer completeness manually.

questions.question: By how many basis points did the State Bank of Vietnam cut its policy rate in April 2020?
questions.absence_reason: Near miss. The only rate cuts with sizes are in the 2020 timeline (p23): Mar 17, 2020 (100 basis points) and May 12, 2020 (50 basis points). No April 2020 cut is reported; searched 'basis point', 'policy rate', 'refinanc' over all 81 pages.

questions.question: What is the electricity price per kWh after the 2019 power tariff increase?
questions.absence_reason: The 2019 edition mentions a hike in the power tariff (p19) and electricity in administered prices (p9), but gives no price level. 'kWh' has 0 hits in all 81 pages.

questions.question: How much is the entrance fee for visiting Hoi An Ancient City?
questions.absence_reason: p54 (2019) only says entrance fees are charged in Hoi An Ancient City as an example of tiered pricing; no amount is given anywhere ('entrance fee' 2 hits, both p54, no number).

questions.question: What GDP growth rate did Vietnam actually record in the first quarter of 2021?
questions.absence_reason: Both editions were published before 2021; they contain only full-year 2021 forecasts (6.5% in the 2019 edition, 6.8% baseline in the 2020 edition), no recorded Q1 2021 figure. 'first quarter of 2021' / 'Q1 2021' have 0 hits.

questions.absence_reason: 'Phu Quoc', 'hotel rooms' and 'occupancy' have 0 hits in all 81 pages; the tourism chapter discusses destinations but not Phu Quoc or room capacity.
